name: Early-2000s-style Gen Z privacy & art blog

mentions.name: Early-2000s-style Gen Z privacy & art blog
mentions.description: A Gen Z-targeted website/blog combining technical guides for censorship evasion and privacy/anonymity with resources on archiving, hacking, pirating, and hosting, plus an art index linking thousands of indie blogs, zines, magazines, music streaming, and DIY craft learning sites. It also features personal articles on contemporary tech topics such as escaping algorithms, anti-AI art, rave/electronica blogging, and the intersection of tech and art, styled with Y2K/liminal/surreal/computer aesthetics resembling an early 2000s blog.
